UK Court Orders Nirav Modi to Pay Bank of India Over ₹100 Crore

A UK court has ordered fugitive diamond merchant Nirav Modi to pay over ₹100 crore to the Bank of India. The ruling came in a loan dispute where the court found Modi's liability valid under a personal guarantee. Modi is currently in UK custody, contesting extradition to India on fraud charges.
